locations.private_posterior: Section 4.2, equations (6),(7), printed page 11: WHITE/BLUE conditional value, with q*=q in Treatment I.
locations.signal_accuracy: Section 4.1, equation (1), printed page 9: correct WHITE/BLUE signal probability 0.7.
locations.treatment_I: Section 4.2, printed page 12: rho=mu=1; an informed trader always buys on WHITE and sells on BLUE.
